headline: Follow-up on Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project form-based code and discussion of a possible road/farm stands ordinance.
summary: The Planning Board will follow up on recent Town Council meetings about the Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project, Form-Based Code, and discuss a possible draft ordinance on road/farm stands. The board will also receive information on the Rt. 1 Stewardship Plan and the Harbor Management Plan.
